flavor: A vast, circular chamber of polished white marble is dominated by a single, massive crystal suspended from the ceiling. Beams of concentrated sunlight pierce through high, narrow slits in the dome, striking the gemstone and scattering dancing, blinding rainbows across the floor.
name: The Prism Refraction
reason: A tripwire triggers a series of rotating mirrors, focusing the sunlight into a searing, concentrated beam that sweeps across the room.
